Class Order

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.order.Order
@Entity public class Order extends Object
Represents a trading order placed for a specific instrument. Decoupled from Account JPA entity: stores accountId directly. Follows the audit lifecycle: SUBMITTED -> ACCEPTED or REJECTED -> FILLED. Orders other than market orders wait in between: SUBMITTED -> OPEN -> ACCEPTED -> FILLED once the market reaches their price, or OPEN -> CANCELLED or EXPIRED if it never does. A market order placed outside regular hours waits OPEN the same way, for the next open.

    • setConditions

      public void setConditions(Order.OrderType orderType, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, Order.TimeInForce timeInForce, OffsetDateTime expiresAt)
      Sets how the order is priced and how long it may wait. Called once, before the order is first stored.
      Parameters:
      orderType - the order type
      limitPrice - the limit price, for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT orders
      stopPrice - the stop price, for STOP and STOP_LIMIT orders
      timeInForce - how long it may wait; null for a market order
      expiresAt - when it expires if still OPEN; null for a market order

    • setExtendedHours

      public void setExtendedHours(boolean extendedHours)
      Lets a LIMIT order also fill in pre-market and after-hours, not only in regular hours. Called once, before the order is first stored.
      Parameters:
      extendedHours - whether it trades in extended hours

    • queueForOpen

      public void queueForOpen(BigDecimal collarPrice, OffsetDateTime expiresAt)
      Queues a market order placed outside regular hours for the next open: it works for that trading day and fills at the opening price, but only within its collar - the most a buy pays, the least a sell takes. Called once, before the order goes OPEN.
      Parameters:
      collarPrice - the collar
      expiresAt - the close of the trading day it is queued for

    • setTrailing

      public void setTrailing(BigDecimal trailAmount, BigDecimal trailPercent)
      Sets how far a trailing stop trails the market: an amount, or a percent of the best price. Exactly one is set. Called once, before the order is first stored.
      Parameters:
      trailAmount - the trail in dollars, or null
      trailPercent - the trail in percent, or null

    • setBracket

      public void setBracket(BigDecimal takeProfitPrice, BigDecimal stopLossPrice)
      Attaches a bracket to a buy: once it fills, a take-profit sell limit and a stop-loss sell stop are opened for the shares. Called once, before the order is first stored.
      Parameters:
      takeProfitPrice - the limit price of the take-profit sell
      stopLossPrice - the stop price of the stop-loss sell
